response.what_it_is: Two-tier small square accent table or coffee table with black faux-marble top and shelf and gold-tone metal legs
visible_condition: No visible scratches or structural damage
hidden_risks: Stability of the detachable joints or screw threads
Material quality of the shelves (MDF vs actual wood or stone)
Scratches or peeling on the gold leg finish
response.failure_mode: Mistaking the flat-pack/detachable assembly for flimsy construction, or misjudging the physical size due to lack of scale reference.
